title: Open letter to President Cyril Ramaphosa: Africa's time to lead the world
by: 82 organisations including Oxfam, Amnesty International, Greenpeace Africa, AbibiNsroma Foundation and GCAP Ghana
summary: Asks South Africa's G20 presidency to champion a tax on the super-rich and states that a 1% wealth tax and 10% income tax on Africa's richest 1% could raise $66 billion a year.
